subject.title: fix(agent): recover disconnected gateway runs before rerunning

question: Should `openclaw agent` wait for and replay an accepted disconnected Gateway run before preserving the existing automatic isolated embedded fallback?
rationale: This is a user-visible reliability and latency policy choice, not a purely mechanical correction: the recovery path changes when users receive output and which run result they receive after an uncertain disconnect.

options.title: Approve layered recovery
options.body: Adopt reattach-first recovery with the existing isolated fallback only after current-head evidence covers both successful recovery and recovery exhaustion.

options.title: Keep immediate fallback
options.body: Retain the current immediate isolated embedded fallback policy and close or narrow this recovery-first branch.

recommendation.title: Approve layered recovery
recommendation.body: Adopt reattach-first recovery with the existing isolated fallback only after current-head evidence covers both successful recovery and recovery exhaustion.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the merged fresh-session fallback policy that the proposed recovery layer changes.
